page.layout: One page of text, one column; running head at top with page number at top right; catchword "Quæ-" at lower right; signature "P 4" at foot centre-left. Show-through text from the reverse side is faint and not transcribed. Faint library/left-edge fragments not transcribed.

main_text.p: sitis infimulabatur criminibus læsæ Majestatis, & magicarum artium, ac etiam cædis cujusdam Proüille: Ex his morti addicitur: Cumque uterum gestare se proclamasset, obstetricum brevi examine præmisso (quod nudum sine re prætextum arguissent) jubetur collum lictori porrigere: Aufa etiam tunc sub umbra collimantis in cervicem gladii, ad districtum Dei tribunal, judicem suum citare: Truncus ad extremum, & caput infelicis Marchionissæ, flammis data.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse page is present in the lower half and was omitted. Some words in the first line are partly obscured by the gutter; "infimulabatur" and "Proüille" are as printed. The catchword "Quæ-" is printed at the lower right of the text block.
